Diep Son Island and Doc Let Beach are among the most fascinating destinations in Nha Trang, famous for their untouched beauty and the extraordinary sand pathway that emerges across the sea. This complete Diep Son – Doc Let travel guide for 2026 provides essential information on transportation, accommodation, activities, and important travel tips to help you plan a smooth and unforgettable journey.

With its pristine landscapes and authentic local culture, Diep Son Island has become a must-visit destination for travelers seeking unique coastal experiences in Vietnam. Let us guide you through everything you need to know before setting off on your adventure to this remarkable island.

Where Is Diep Son Island And When Is The Best Time To Visit?

Diep Son Island is a small archipelago located in Van Phong Bay, Khanh Hoa Province, approximately 60 kilometers north of Nha Trang city. The archipelago consists of three small islands Hon Bip, Hon Oc, and Hon Qua connected by a natural white sand pathway nearly one kilometer long, hidden beneath crystal-clear seawater.

This sand path only appears when the tide recedes, creating a magical scene where visitors can walk seemingly in the middle of the ocean. It is the island’s most iconic feature and one of the most unique natural phenomena in Vietnam.

The best time to visit Diep Son Island is from March to September, when the weather is sunny, dry, and the sea is calm. These conditions are ideal for sightseeing, swimming, and walking along the sand path. Visitors should avoid the rainy and stormy season from October to February, as rough seas may disrupt transportation. Checking the tidal schedule in advance is highly recommended, as the sand path is usually visible in the early morning or late afternoon.

How To Get To Diep Son Island And Doc Let Beach

From Nha Trang To Van Gia Port Or Diep Son Port

  • By Coach Or Taxi: Travel from Nha Trang city center to Van Gia Port in Van Ninh District. The journey takes approximately 1.5–2 hours. Coach fares range from 50,000 to 100,000 VND per person, while taxi fares range from 500,000 to 700,000 VND per trip.

  • By Motorbike: Renting a motorbike is ideal for travelers who enjoy freedom and scenic coastal routes. Rental prices range from 100,000 to 150,000 VND per day.

  • By Organized Tour: Many travel agencies offer full-day or overnight Diep Son – Doc Let tours, including transportation, boat transfers, meals, and guided activities.

From Van Gia Port To Diep Son Island

  • Wooden Boat: Local boats operate daily, usually departing in the morning and returning in the afternoon. Round-trip fares range from 150,000 to 200,000 VND per person.

  • Speedboat (Canoe): A faster option, taking only 15–20 minutes to reach the island. Prices range from 250,000 to 300,000 VND per person for a round trip.

Accommodation Options On Diep Son Island And Doc Let

Local Homestays

Staying with local families is the most popular and authentic option on Diep Son Island. The island’s residents are warm and welcoming, and this experience offers insight into daily life in a traditional fishing community.

Camping On The Beach

For adventurous travelers, camping overnight is a memorable experience. With permission from local authorities, visitors can set up tents on the beach or near the schoolyard. Nights on the island are peaceful, with star-filled skies and the sound of waves.

Hotels And Resorts In Doc Let

If you prefer modern amenities, Doc Let Beach offers a wide range of hotels, resorts, and guesthouses. Staying in Doc Let allows easy access to Diep Son Island for day trips while enjoying comfortable accommodation.

What To Do On Diep Son Island

Walk On The Iconic Sand Path Across The Sea

Walking along the sand pathway during low tide is the highlight of any Diep Son visit. Surrounded by turquoise water, the experience feels surreal and offers exceptional photo opportunities.

Kayaking And Coastal Exploration

Kayaking allows visitors to explore hidden corners of the island, rocky shorelines, and the clear waters of Van Phong Bay at a relaxed pace.

Swimming And Beach Relaxation

The island’s beaches feature soft white sand and emerald-blue water, perfect for swimming and peaceful relaxation away from crowds.

Discover Local Fishing Village Life

Visitors can explore the island’s fishing villages, interact with locals, and learn about traditional livelihoods such as net fishing and seafood preparation.

Enjoy Fresh Seafood

Seafood on Diep Son Island is freshly caught and simply prepared, enhancing its natural flavors. Grilled squid, steamed snails, grilled fish, and anchovy salad are highly recommended.

Important Travel Tips For Diep Son – Doc Let

  • Bring essential personal items, including sunscreen, hats, medicine, flashlights, and power banks.

  • Electricity on the island is available only at certain hours.

  • Freshwater is limited use it wisely.

  • Protect the environment by taking all trash back to the mainland.

  • Respect local customs and maintain quiet behavior.

  • Book boat transfers and accommodation in advance during peak season.

  • Always check tidal schedules for safety when walking on the sand path.

Suggested Diep Son – Doc Let Itinerary (2 Days 1 Night)

Day 1: Explore Diep Son Island

  • Morning: Travel from Nha Trang to Van Gia Port, then transfer to Diep Son Island.

  • Afternoon: Walk on the sand path, swim, kayak, and relax.

  • Evening: Enjoy a seafood barbecue and stargazing on the beach.

Day 2: Doc Let Beach And Return

  • Morning: Sunrise viewing, breakfast, and return to the mainland.

  • Midday: Visit Doc Let Beach, swim, relax, and enjoy lunch at a beachfront restaurant.

  • Afternoon: Return to Nha Trang.

Diep Son Island and Doc Let Beach are true hidden gems of Khanh Hoa Province, offering rare natural beauty, peaceful surroundings, and unforgettable experiences. With its iconic sand path, crystal-clear waters, and friendly local community, this destination is perfect for travelers seeking a meaningful escape close to nature. We hope this guide helps you plan a truly memorable Diep Son – Doc Let adventure in 2026.
